About Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah:
--------------------------------------------------------------------
The show is inspired from the famous humorous column 'Duniya Ne Undha Chasma' written by the eminent Gujarati writer Mr. Tarak Mehta. This story revolves around daily happenings in "Gokuldham Co-operative Society" and covers topical issues which are socially relevant. The show predominantly - revolves around 'Jethalal' who is an uneducated Gujarati businessman. Your 'Taarak Mehta', is his neighbor. 'Jethalal' finds a friend and philosopher in 'Taarak Mehta' and often goes to him for advice whenever he is in trouble. Jethalaal's family includes his simpleton wife 'Daya Ben' and a mischievous son 'Tapu'. Tapu is a menace and a constant source of trouble to all the members of Gokuldham. They have often warned 'Jethalal' to reform 'Tapu' or else be prepared to leave the premises. Lost hopes of being heard by his son push Jethalal' to call his father 'Champaklal' from the village. This was his great idea of leashing some control over the mischievous Tapu. The opposite happens and the grandfather joins hands with the grandson to make life a roller coaster troublesome ride for Jethalal.

snippet.title: Is this doing too much for a 4 year old toddler? #ytshorts #momlife #viral #shorts #trendingshorts
snippet.description:
#AD Writing this for all the moms who get told that their kids are old enough to do everything themselves! ❤️

My 4-year-old can brush, get dressed and do so many things independently, but there are still a few things I love helping him with.

From supervising his morning brushing to making bath time fun with Tedibar Body Wash and getting him ready for school… these little everyday moments mean so much to me.

I know one day he'll do everything on his own. But until then, let me enjoy being his mom in these little ways. 🥹❤️

Every child grows at their own pace, and independence doesn't mean we have to stop helping them.

What are the things you still do for your little ones?

snippet.title: "Bu...Bukain Pintunya. Aku di Luar..." Padahal Adik Tidur di Kamar | Jangan Ada Cahaya Part 5 #horor
snippet.description:
Kalau suara keluargamu bisa ditiru... siapa yang kamu percaya?

Part 5 melanjutkan malam yang sama. Petugas evakuasi yang memohon di pagar terjatuh tepat di depan rumah. Ibu hendak membuka pintu, tapi Ayah menahannya. Lalu sesuatu yang hitam menerjangnya dari belakang.

Hampir sebulan kemudian, makanan menipis, air dibatasi, kampung kosong, dan siaran pemerintah berhenti. Sampai suatu malam pintu depan diketuk: "Buka pintunya... kami dari tim evakuasi." Pesan darurat di ponsel Ayah berkata lain: jangan buka pintu kepada siapa pun, petugas resmi selalu menyebut kode identifikasi.

Kode itu tidak pernah disebut. Suara di luar justru tahu mereka berempat... lalu berubah menjadi suara Adik.

Coba dengarkan lagi suara pertama di balik pintu. Pernah dengar di awal video? 👀

Yang nyata di video ini:
🔑 FBI menganjurkan setiap keluarga menyepakati kata atau frasa rahasia, karena penipu memakai AI untuk meniru suara anggota keluarga yang seolah sedang darurat.
🎙️ Dalam uji McAfee, klip suara sekitar 3 detik sudah cukup untuk membuat tiruan suara yang mirip.
🪪 Seragam bukan tanda pengenal. Mintalah identitas resmi berfoto; petugas FEMA bahkan memakai kode registrasi yang hanya diketahui kedua pihak.
💧 Air minum jangan dijatah kecuali diperintahkan petugas: minum yang dibutuhkan hari ini, cari lagi untuk besok. Yang boleh dihemat adalah makanan.

Kalau kamu Ayah, apa yang kamu lakukan sekarang? Tulis di komentar 👇
Belum nonton Part 1 sampai 4? Tonton dulu biar nyambung. Part 6 segera.

Ceritanya fiksi. Faktanya nyata.
Musik: Mixkit (Mixkit License) - "A Voice from The Past", "Delirium", "Goats", "Fragments Of Bangkok" (Eugenio Mininni), "Dark Shadows" (Ahjay Stelino), "Piano Horror", dan lainnya; latar ElevenLabs Music dari Part 3.

snippet.title: Hollywood’s Fastest Hands Bad Guy Jet Li
snippet.description:
Lethal Weapon 4 (1998) was Jet Li’s Hollywood debut, playing Wah Sing Ku opposite Mel Gibson and Danny Glover. We were supposed to be rooting against him, but I kept waiting for his next scene. He barely had to speak to make you nervous. South China Morning Post

This old E! News Daily set visit gives us a much friendlier Jet. An interviewer asks him to demonstrate a move, a few people join in the teasing, and he takes it all with a smile. The footage survives through a VHS upload by kezisallknowing, who explains that it was originally recorded in SLP/EP mode. That’s where the soft picture comes from. YouTube

We’ve talked about his speed on this channel before. In a 2005 interview with Conan O’Brien, Jet recalled being warned not to hurt Mel Gibson. After a fast sequence on their first day working together, Gibson asked how many movements he had made. Jet said seven. According to Jet, Gibson had only seen two. Watching this little demonstration, that story becomes easier to appreciate. YouTube

What I also like is how Jet described taking the role back in 1998: he saw it as an opportunity to learn English and understand how American movies were made. He was already a star, and he still wanted to learn. South China Morning Post

His speed is worth replaying, but that grin when everyone starts joking around is my favorite part. These little recordings make me miss the old action films all over again. I’d happily sit through a whole tape of this.

Director: Richard Donner

snippet.title: A 747's Rudder Stuck Hard Left With 404 Aboard
snippet.description:
On 9 October 2002, over the Bering Sea, the lower rudder of Northwest Airlines flight 85, a Boeing 747-400 with 404 people on board, swung hard left on its own. The jet was at 35,000 ft on autopilot, and it rolled left 31 degrees in seven seconds. A part in the rudder's hydraulic unit had cracked through from metal fatigue, and no emergency procedure could fix it. The crew turned back for Anchorage and flew by hand for almost two hours, taking turns on the rudder pedal. Slowing to land made it worse: the stuck rudder moved from 17.5 to its full 32 degrees. Senior Captain John Hanson landed at 185 knots, about 30 knots faster than normal, as night fell. Everyone lived.

Sources: National Transportation Safety Board, Aviation Investigation Final Report ANC03IA001, Northwest Airlines Flight 85, Anchorage, Alaska, 9 October 2002, and its public docket 55881; the Air Line Pilots Association's account of the crew's Superior Airmanship Award (2003); and Captain John Hanson's own account (Jalopnik, 7 September 2010). This is a reconstruction, built in Blender and finished in DaVinci Resolve. No real footage or recordings are used. The narrator reads Captain John Hanson's words from his own account.

snippet.title: ¡ESPOSADA Y SONRIENDO! Así salió "la muñeca de la mafia" tras allanamiento en SPS
snippet.description:
Agentes de la Agencia Técnica de Investigación Criminal (ATIC) y elementos de la Policía Militar del Orden Público (PMOP) ejecutaron el traslado bajo custodia de la hondureña Kensy García Torres, conocida como "La Muñeca de la Mafia", tras completar el allanamiento en su vivienda ubicada en la residencial Cedritos de San Pedro Sula. En el operativo participó el subdirector de la ATIC, quien permaneció más de una hora dentro del inmueble durante las diligencias previas a la salida de la detenida. De acuerdo con lo informado por el Ministerio Público, García Torres será enjuiciada por el delito de lavado de activos agravado, luego de haber cumplido una condena de tres años de prisión en Estados Unidos y contar con una medida de dos años adicionales bajo vigilancia. Según datos recabados en el lugar, la vivienda en la residencial Cedritos había permanecido incautada y le fue devuelta hace aproximadamente cuatro meses, momento desde el cual residía en ella junto a su madre y su hija antes de efectuarse su captura.
